units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> (play on <cite ref="O00218"><he>סהר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:3">Cant. VII, 3</cite>) <he>בשעה … הס׳ והשכר היו בעולם</he> when they (the Sanhedrin) were in session, there were traffic and profit in the world.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:5">Ab. II, 5</cite> <he>לא כל המרבה בס׳ מחכים</he> not every one that has a large trade obtains wisdom.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:2">B. Mets. III, 2</cite> <he>כיצד הלה עושה ס׳ וכ׳</he> how (can this be)? Shall this man traffic with his neighbor’s cow? <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 23:1">Sifré Num. 23</cite> <he>שומע אני מסְחוֹרָתוֹ ומרפואתו</he> I might understand, that the Nazarite must abstain from trading in wine or using it as external medicine; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 6:6">Ab. VI</cite> <he>במיעוט ס׳</he> by contentment with small business; a. fr.
